Brewers Off to the Playoffs
The National League Central Division crown remains up for grabs, but the <Milwaukee Brewers:team#16> have already guaranteed themselves a spot in the playoffs after today's games.

"We're still hungry for more and to get ourselves in even better position for the playoffs," said starting pitcher <Kyle Harrison:player#46665>.

At a record of 85-74, the Brewers will be trying to finish strong this year, in hopes of sparking a playoff run that leads to the 1st World Series victory in franchise history.
